# Brand Scaling

> Brand Scaling (legal name Brand Scaling Hacks LLC) is a DTC ecommerce growth agency that scales Shopify brands with Meta and TikTok ads, direct-response creative and conversion rate optimization. Founded by Gaurav Kapoor. 12+ years of ecommerce experience, $50M+ in Meta ad spend managed, 30+ niches, 150+ published case studies. Serves brands in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada and Australia.

Brand Scaling works with DTC and ecommerce brands doing about $20K to $2M+ per month in revenue with product-market fit, typically spending at least $10,000 to $20,000 per month on paid ads. Engagements start with a Brand Growth Audit: a 1-on-1 diagnostic of Meta ad accounts, creative performance, conversion bottlenecks and unit economics.

## Services
- [Ecommerce growth agency](https://brandscalinghacks.com/growth): Meta, TikTok and Google media buying, creative, Shopify CRO and retention as one system
- [Performance marketing agency for ecommerce](https://brandscalinghacks.com/): overview, results and process (Foundation, Test, Optimize, Scale)
- [Shopify agency](https://brandscalinghacks.com/shopify-agency): store builds, product page optimization, offers, checkout and CRO testing
- [Direct-response video creatives and UGC](https://brandscalinghacks.com/viral-creatives): 30 to 50+ angle iterations per month

## Proof
- [Case studies](https://brandscalinghacks.com/case-studies): verified revenue and ROAS results from client ad accounts
- Example results: $2.3M in sales at 11.6x ROAS on $200K ad spend; $1.6M on $140K ad spend at 11.98x ROAS; $146,184 in 27 days on $40.1K spend for a skincare brand

## Tools
- [Free ROAS calculator](https://brandscalinghacks.com/roas-calculator): break-even ROAS and profit per order
